query:
-- 1. Add new renter info columns to bookings
ALTER TABLE bookings 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS renterFullName VARCHAR(200) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS renterCpf VARCHAR(14) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS renterEmail VARCHAR(200) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS renterPhone VARCHAR(20) NULL;

-- 2. Modify status enum to include new values
ALTER TABLE bookings 
  MODIFY COLUMN status ENUM(
    'pending_payment',
    'pending',
    'awaiting_verification',
    'pending_host_approval',
    'confirmed',
    'in_progress',
    'completed',
    'cancelled_by_renter',
    'cancelled_by_host',
    'disputed',
    'rejected_verification'
  ) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_payment';

-- 3. Add verificationStatus column
ALTER TABLE bookings
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verificationStatus ENUM(
    'not_required',
    'pending_submission',
    'pending_review',
    'approved',
    'rejected'
  ) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_submission';

-- 4. Create booking_verifications table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS booking_verifications (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  bookingId INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  renterId INT NOT NULL,
  cnhImageUrl TEXT NULL,
  selfieImageUrl TEXT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending_review', 'approved', 'rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review',
  rejectionReason TEXT NULL,
  reviewedBy INT NULL,
  reviewedAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
  submissionCount INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  lastSubmittedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
